test_interrupt_make_observation: test the InterruptMakeObservation component with a scheduler and action spec to verify observation generation
test_entity_name_extraction: test the _get_entity_name method extracts entity names from call_to_action strings with standard and multi-word formats
test_pending_events_observation: test that pending events are included as a catch-up summary in the observation for a polled entity
test_wrong_output_type: test that pre_act returns an empty string when the action spec output type is not MAKE_OBSERVATION
test_not_polled_entity: test that pre_act returns empty when the extracted entity is not in the current polled entities list
